description.value: Enterprise software company in Silicon Valley that makes data catalog software.
A data and AI governance company whose product is the Alation Intelligence Operating System (AIOS).
Privately held enterprise software company in Redwood City, California, whose main product is a data catalog.

product_description.value: Alation Intelligence Operating System (AIOS) modules: Catalog, Lineage, Quality, Curation, Critical Data Manager, Data Products, Marketplace, Ontologies, Analytics, Agents, and Connectors + SDKs.
Alation Data Catalog, launched in 2015, lets users search enterprise data using natural language.
Enterprise catalog covering metadata management and governance, with lineage tracking and connectors to systems such as Snowflake and Redshift.

business_model_description.value: Sells subscription licenses and support contracts, with professional services for onboarding; one profile cites a starting price of about $60,000 for a 12-month catalog subscription.

customer_description.value: Named logos on the company site include BBC, Brambles, Cisco, CNA, Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, Euromonitor International, Finnair, Georgia Pacific, 8451, Japan Airlines, Lipton Teas and Infusions, M&S, Nasdaq, NTT docomo, Sallie Mae and Veolia.
Over 570 enterprise customers in 32 countries as of 2023, including Cisco, Pfizer and Nasdaq (one profile); Bloor Research reports over 500 enterprise customers.

revenue.value: Over $100 million in annual recurring revenue by September 2022 (Bloor Research)
$176.1M (StartupHub estimate, very wide range; year not stated)

locations.value: 3 Lagoon Dr, Suite 300, Redwood City, CA 94065
